examples.en: She has an analytical mind and enjoys solving math problems.
examples.zh: 她頭腦善於分析，喜歡解數學題。

examples.en: The report takes an analytical approach to the sales data.
examples.zh: 這份報告以分析的方式處理銷售資料。

examples.en: Analytical skills are important for this job.
examples.zh: 分析能力對這份工作很重要。

examples.en: The sailors dropped the anchor near the small harbor.
examples.zh: 水手們在小港口附近拋下了錨。

examples.en: Our teacher is the anchor of the whole class.
examples.zh: 我們的老師是全班的精神支柱。

examples.en: The news anchor read the headlines at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 新聞主播在六點鐘播報頭條新聞。

examples.en: The ship will anchor outside the bay tonight.
examples.zh: 這艘船今晚會在海灣外拋錨。

examples.en: Please anchor the tent firmly to the ground.
examples.zh: 請把帳篷牢牢固定在地面上。

examples.en: They anchor the shelf to the wall with strong screws.
examples.zh: 他們用堅固的螺絲把架子固定在牆上。

examples.en: A warm smile can animate a quiet room.
examples.zh: 溫暖的笑容能讓安靜的房間活絡起來。

examples.en: The studio will animate the story for television.
examples.zh: 這家工作室將把這個故事製作成電視動畫。

examples.en: Good music helped animate the whole party.
examples.zh: 好聽的音樂讓整場派對熱鬧了起來。

examples.en: Plants and animals are animate, but rocks are not.
examples.zh: 植物和動物是有生命的，但石頭不是。

examples.en: Scientists study animate and inanimate objects in different ways.
examples.zh: 科學家用不同的方式研究有生命與無生命的物體。

examples.en: The test asked whether each noun was animate.
examples.zh: 測驗要求判斷每個名詞是否指稱有生命的事物。

examples.en: She sighed in annoyance when the bus was late again.
examples.zh: 公車又誤點了，她惱怒地嘆了口氣。

examples.en: Loud phone calls on the train are a common annoyance.
examples.zh: 在火車上大聲講電話是常見的惱人行為。

examples.en: He could not hide his annoyance at the long wait.
examples.zh: 他掩飾不住對漫長等待的不耐煩。

examples.en: Everyone stood up when the national anthem began.
examples.zh: 國歌響起時，大家都站了起來。

examples.en: The school anthem is sung at every graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 每場畢業典禮都會唱校歌。

examples.en: That song became the anthem of the summer.
examples.zh: 那首歌成了這個夏天的主題曲。

examples.en: The doctor gave me an antibiotic for my throat infection.
examples.zh: 醫師開了抗生素給我治療喉嚨感染。

examples.en: You should finish the whole course of the antibiotic.
examples.zh: 你應該把整個療程的抗生素吃完。

examples.en: This antibiotic is not effective against the flu.
examples.zh: 這種抗生素對流感沒有效。

examples.en: The hospital uses an antibiotic cream on small wounds.
examples.zh: 醫院在小傷口上使用抗生素藥膏。

examples.en: Antibiotic treatment can take several days to work.
examples.zh: 抗生素治療可能需要幾天才會見效。

examples.en: Farmers are limiting the use of antibiotic drugs on animals.
examples.zh: 農民正在限制對動物使用抗生素藥物。

examples.en: The children waited with great anticipation for the school trip.
examples.zh: 孩子們滿心期待地等著校外教學。

examples.en: In anticipation of the storm, we bought extra water.
examples.zh: 預期暴風雨將來襲，我們多買了一些水。

examples.en: There was a feeling of anticipation before the concert began.
examples.zh: 演唱會開始前，現場瀰漫著期待的氣氛。

examples.en: The antonym of hot is cold, as shown in this exercise.
examples.zh: 如這個練習所示，「熱」的反義詞是「冷」。

examples.en: Can you think of an antonym for the word brave?
examples.zh: 你想得出「勇敢」這個字的反義詞嗎？

examples.en: Our English test included a section on synonyms and antonyms.
examples.zh: 我們的英文考試有一個關於同義詞和反義詞的部分。

examples.en: This rule is applicable to all students in the school.
examples.zh: 這項規定適用於學校的所有學生。

examples.en: Please fill in the form if it is applicable to you.
examples.zh: 如果這份表格適用於你，請填寫。

examples.en: The discount is not applicable to sale items.
examples.zh: 這項折扣不適用於特價商品。

examples.en: He worked as an apprentice in a bakery for two years.
examples.zh: 他在一家麵包店當了兩年學徒。

examples.en: The young apprentice learned how to repair watches.
examples.zh: 這位年輕的學徒學會了如何修理手錶。

examples.en: Every apprentice needs patience and a good teacher.
examples.zh: 每位學徒都需要耐心與一位好老師。

examples.en: The approximate cost of the trip is five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行的大約花費是五千元。

examples.en: Please give me an approximate arrival time.
examples.zh: 請告訴我大約的抵達時間。

examples.en: His answer was only approximate, not exact.
examples.zh: 他的答案只是近似值，並不精確。

examples.en: The shape of the cloud seemed to approximate a heart.
examples.zh: 那朵雲的形狀看起來近似一顆心。

examples.en: Can you approximate the number of people in the room?
examples.zh: 你能大致估計房間裡的人數嗎？

examples.en: The model tries to approximate real weather conditions.
examples.zh: 這個模型試圖呈現接近真實的天氣狀況。

examples.en: She studies archaeology at a university in Tainan.
examples.zh: 她在台南的一所大學讀考古學。

examples.en: Archaeology helps us learn about ancient cultures.
examples.zh: 考古學幫助我們認識古代文化。

examples.en: The museum has a special exhibit on archaeology.
examples.zh: 博物館有一場關於考古學的特展。

examples.en: The library keeps old newspapers in its archive.
examples.zh: 圖書館把舊報紙保存在檔案庫裡。

examples.en: I found the photo in the school archive.
examples.zh: 我在學校的檔案庫裡找到了那張照片。

examples.en: The city archive is open to the public on weekdays.
examples.zh: 市立檔案館平日對外開放。

examples.en: Please archive all the old emails from last year.
examples.zh: 請把去年的舊電子郵件全部存檔。

examples.en: The office will archive these documents next month.
examples.zh: 辦公室下個月會把這些文件存檔。

examples.en: We archive our photos on an external hard drive.
examples.zh: 我們把照片存檔在外接硬碟裡。

examples.en: My little brother has asthma and carries an inhaler.
examples.zh: 我弟弟有氣喘，隨身帶著吸入器。

examples.en: Cold air can make her asthma worse.
examples.zh: 冷空氣會讓她的氣喘更嚴重。

examples.en: Asthma often starts in childhood, but adults can develop it too.
examples.zh: 氣喘常在兒童時期發病，但成人也可能罹患。

examples.en: The little dog wandered astray in the busy market.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗在熱鬧的市場裡走失了。

examples.en: Our plans went astray because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 我們的計畫因為大雨而出了差錯。

examples.en: Bad friends led him astray during high school.
examples.zh: 高中時期，壞朋友把他帶入了歧途。

examples.en: The astronomer used a large telescope to look at Mars.
examples.zh: 天文學家用大型望遠鏡觀察火星。

examples.en: An astronomer discovered a new comet last night.
examples.zh: 一位天文學家昨晚發現了一顆新彗星。

examples.en: She wants to become an astronomer when she grows up.
examples.zh: 她長大後想成為天文學家。

examples.en: Our school has an astronomy club that meets on Fridays.
examples.zh: 我們學校有一個星期五聚會的天文社。

examples.en: Astronomy is the study of stars and planets.
examples.zh: 天文學是研究恆星與行星的學問。

examples.en: He bought a book on astronomy for his nephew.
examples.zh: 他買了一本天文學的書給他的姪子。

examples.en: She worked hard to attain her goal of becoming a nurse.
examples.zh: 她努力工作，要達成成為護理師的目標。

examples.en: Few students can attain a perfect score on this exam.
examples.zh: 很少有學生能在這場考試中拿到滿分。

examples.en: It takes years of practice to attain this level of skill.
examples.zh: 要達到這種技術水準需要多年的練習。

examples.en: The flight attendant offered us water and snacks.
examples.zh: 空服員為我們提供了水和點心。

examples.en: A parking attendant showed us where to leave the car.
examples.zh: 停車場服務人員告訴我們把車停在哪裡。

examples.en: The museum attendant answered our questions politely.
examples.zh: 博物館的服務人員有禮貌地回答了我們的問題。

examples.en: The company passes an audit every year.
examples.zh: 這家公司每年都會通過查帳。

examples.en: The auditor found an error during the audit.
examples.zh: 審計人員在查帳時發現了一處錯誤。

examples.en: An audit of the school budget will take two weeks.
examples.zh: 學校預算的審計需要兩週。

examples.en: The firm will audit our accounts in March.
examples.zh: 這家事務所將在三月查核我們的帳目。

examples.en: They audit the records to make sure the numbers are correct.
examples.zh: 他們查核紀錄，確保數字無誤。

examples.en: She plans to audit a history course at the local university.
examples.zh: 她計畫在當地大學旁聽一門歷史課。

examples.en: The graduation ceremony was held in the school auditorium.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮在學校禮堂舉行。

examples.en: The auditorium can seat more than five hundred people.
examples.zh: 這座禮堂可容納五百多人。

examples.en: Students lined up outside the auditorium before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前，學生們在禮堂外排隊。

examples.en: Quick action helped avert a serious accident.
examples.zh: 迅速的行動幫助避免了一場嚴重的意外。

examples.en: She looked down to avert her eyes from the bright light.
examples.zh: 她低下頭，把視線從強光移開。

examples.en: The two countries worked together to avert a crisis.
examples.zh: 兩國攜手合作，避免了一場危機。

examples.en: He works in the aviation industry as an engineer.
examples.zh: 他在航空業擔任工程師。

examples.en: The museum has a hall about the history of aviation.
examples.zh: 博物館有一個介紹航空史的展廳。

examples.en: Aviation safety rules are very strict to protect passengers and crew.
examples.zh: 航空安全規定非常嚴格，以保障乘客和機組人員的安全。

examples.en: We had an awesome time at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊玩得很開心。

examples.en: Your new bike looks awesome with its bright blue frame!
examples.zh: 你的新腳踏車配上亮藍色的車架，看起來好棒！

examples.en: The view from the top of the mountain was awesome.
examples.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色令人驚嘆。

examples.en: Let's rest awhile before we continue walking.
examples.zh: 我們先休息一會兒，再繼續走。

examples.en: She stayed awhile to help us clean the classroom.
examples.zh: 她留了一會兒，幫我們打掃教室。

examples.en: Wait awhile and the soup will cool down.
examples.zh: 等一會兒，湯就會涼了。

examples.en: My uncle is a bachelor and lives alone in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是單身漢，獨自住在台北。

examples.en: She earned a bachelor's degree in business last year.
examples.zh: 她去年取得了商學學士學位。

examples.en: He is a bachelor of science from a national university.
examples.zh: 他是國立大學的理學學士。

examples.en: A strong backbone helps the body stay upright.
examples.zh: 強健的脊椎幫助身體保持挺直。

examples.en: Small businesses are the backbone of the local economy.
examples.zh: 小型企業是地方經濟的骨幹。

examples.en: It takes backbone to admit your mistakes in public.
examples.zh: 在眾人面前承認錯誤需要骨氣。

examples.en: Each student wears a name badge on the first day.
examples.zh: 每位學生第一天都會戴上名牌。

examples.en: The scout proudly showed us his new badge.
examples.zh: 那位童軍自豪地向我們展示他的新徽章。

examples.en: Please show your badge to the guard at the gate.
examples.zh: 請向大門的警衛出示你的識別證。

examples.en: The company held a banquet for its employees at a hotel.
examples.zh: 公司在飯店為員工舉辦了一場宴會。

examples.en: We were invited to a wedding banquet last Saturday.
examples.zh: 上週六我們受邀參加婚宴。

examples.en: The chef prepared a huge banquet for the guests.
examples.zh: 主廚為賓客準備了一場豐盛的宴席。

examples.en: The movie is about a barbarian who invades a city.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一個入侵城市的野蠻人。

examples.en: Our history textbook explains why ancient Romans called foreign tribes barbarians.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史課本解釋了古羅馬人為何把外族稱為野蠻人。

examples.en: Don't act like a barbarian at the dinner table.
examples.zh: 在餐桌上別表現得像個野蠻人。

examples.en: He plays the bass in a school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂團裡彈貝斯。

examples.en: The speakers have a deep bass that shakes the floor.
examples.zh: 這些喇叭的低音很深沉，連地板都在震動。

examples.en: My father caught a large bass at the lake.
examples.zh: 我爸爸在湖裡釣到了一條大鱸魚。

examples.en: Her brother sings in the bass section of the choir.
examples.zh: 她哥哥在合唱團的低音部唱歌。

examples.en: The bass drum set the rhythm of the march.
examples.zh: 大鼓定下了行進的節奏。

examples.en: He has a deep bass voice that suits the choir.
examples.zh: 他有一副低沉的男低音嗓音，很適合合唱團。

examples.en: The batter swung and hit the ball over the fence.
examples.zh: 打擊手一揮棒，把球打過了圍欄。

examples.en: Mix the flour and eggs to make a smooth batter.
examples.zh: 把麵粉和蛋混合，調成滑順的麵糊。

examples.en: The next batter stepped up to the plate.
examples.zh: 下一位打擊手走上了打擊區。

examples.en: Strong waves batter the coast every winter.
examples.zh: 每年冬天強浪都會猛烈拍打海岸。

examples.en: The wind began to batter the old wooden door.
examples.zh: 風開始猛烈撞擊那扇老舊的木門。

examples.en: Heavy rain continued to batter the town all night.
examples.zh: 大雨整夜持續襲擊小鎮。

examples.en: Students planted flowers to beautify the school yard.
examples.zh: 學生們種花來美化校園。

examples.en: The city plans to beautify the park before the festival.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫在節慶前美化公園。

examples.en: We bought paint to beautify our living room.
examples.zh: 我們買了油漆來美化客廳。

examples.en: I heard a beep from my phone.
examples.zh: 我聽到手機發出嗶的一聲。

examples.en: Please leave a message after the beep.
examples.zh: 請在嗶聲後留言。

examples.en: The microwave gave a loud beep when the food was ready.
examples.zh: 食物熱好時，微波爐發出響亮的嗶聲。

examples.en: The alarm will beep if the door stays open.
examples.zh: 如果門一直開著，警報器就會嗶嗶響。

examples.en: The taxi driver began to beep at the slow truck.
examples.zh: 計程車司機對著慢吞吞的卡車按起了喇叭。

examples.en: My watch beeps every hour to remind me to stretch.
examples.zh: 我的手錶每小時都會嗶嗶響，提醒我伸展身體。

examples.en: Please call us beforehand if you plan to visit.
examples.zh: 如果你打算來訪，請事先打電話給我們。

examples.en: I studied the map beforehand, so we did not get lost.
examples.zh: 我事先看過地圖，所以我們沒有迷路。

examples.en: They told the guests about the change beforehand.
examples.zh: 他們事先告知了賓客這項變動。

examples.en: The hotel offers a free welcome beverage to every guest.
examples.zh: 這家飯店提供每位客人一杯免費的迎賓飲料。

examples.en: Hot and cold beverages are sold at the school store.
examples.zh: 學校的福利社販售熱飲和冷飲。

examples.en: Which beverage would you like with your meal?
examples.zh: 你的餐點想搭配哪種飲料？

examples.en: The two countries signed a bilateral trade agreement.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署了雙邊貿易協定。

examples.en: The doctor checked for bilateral swelling in both legs.
examples.zh: 醫師檢查雙腿是否都出現腫脹。

examples.en: Bilateral talks will start next week in Tokyo.
examples.zh: 雙邊會談下週將在東京展開。

examples.en: Firefighters worked all night to stop the blaze.
examples.zh: 消防人員整晚努力撲滅大火。

examples.en: The campfire grew into a bright blaze.
examples.zh: 營火燒成了明亮的烈焰。

examples.en: A blaze destroyed the old warehouse before firefighters could reach it.
examples.zh: 消防人員趕到之前，一場大火就燒毀了那間舊倉庫。

examples.en: The fire began to blaze in the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁爐裡的火開始熊熊燃燒。

examples.en: The sun blazed down on the empty street.
examples.zh: 烈日炙烤著空蕩蕩的街道。

examples.en: Lights blaze from every window of the tall building.
examples.zh: 高樓的每扇窗戶都燈火通明。

examples.en: Be careful not to spill bleach on your clothes.
examples.zh: 小心不要把漂白水灑在衣服上。

examples.en: My mother cleans the bathroom with bleach.
examples.zh: 我媽媽用漂白水清潔浴室。

examples.en: Bleach should be kept away from children.
examples.zh: 漂白水應該放在小孩拿不到的地方。

examples.en: She used lemon juice to bleach the old shirt.
examples.zh: 她用檸檬汁漂白那件舊襯衫。

examples.en: The strong sun can bleach the color from curtains.
examples.zh: 強烈的陽光會使窗簾褪色。

examples.en: He decided to bleach his hair for the school play.
examples.zh: 他決定為學校的戲劇演出替頭髮漂色。

examples.en: There was a large ink blot on my homework.
examples.zh: 我的作業上有一大塊墨漬。

examples.en: The blot on the white shirt would not come out.
examples.zh: 那件白襯衫上的汙漬洗不掉。

examples.en: A single blot spoiled the beautiful painting.
examples.zh: 一個汙點毀了那幅美麗的畫。

examples.en: Use a paper towel to blot the spilled juice.
examples.zh: 用紙巾把灑出來的果汁吸乾。

examples.en: Be careful not to blot your page with the leaking pen.
examples.zh: 小心別讓那支漏墨的筆把你的紙頁弄髒。

examples.en: She tried to blot the water from her notebook.
examples.zh: 她試著把筆記本上的水吸乾。

examples.en: This knife is too blunt to cut the bread.
examples.zh: 這把刀太鈍了，切不了麵包。

examples.en: He gave a blunt answer to the question.
examples.zh: 他對這個問題給出了直率的回答。

examples.en: The teacher was blunt about my poor test results.
examples.zh: 老師直言我的考試成績很差。

examples.en: Using a pencil on rough paper will blunt it quickly.
examples.zh: 在粗糙的紙上用鉛筆會讓筆尖很快變鈍。

examples.en: Years of failure did not blunt her hope.
examples.zh: 多年的失敗並沒有削弱她的希望。

examples.en: Cold weather can blunt your sense of taste.
examples.zh: 寒冷的天氣可能會讓味覺變遲鈍。

examples.en: The doctor asked about my bodily pain.
examples.zh: 醫師詢問我身體上的疼痛。

examples.en: Adequate sleep is a basic bodily need for people of all ages.
examples.zh: 充足的睡眠是各年齡層的基本身體需求。

examples.en: This job requires bodily strength because workers lift heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要體力，因為工人要搬重箱子。

examples.en: The crowd lifted the winner bodily into the air.
examples.zh: 群眾把優勝者整個人抬到空中。

examples.en: He carried the sleeping child bodily to the car.
examples.zh: 他把熟睡的孩子整個抱到車上。

examples.en: The wind picked the small boy up bodily.
examples.zh: 風把那個小男孩整個吹了起來。

examples.en: She held the baby close to her bosom.
examples.zh: 她把嬰兒緊緊抱在胸前。

examples.en: The children felt safe in the bosom of their family.
examples.zh: 孩子們在家人的懷抱中感到安心。

examples.en: He felt a warm feeling in his bosom.
examples.zh: 他心裡感到一股暖意。

examples.en: We walked along the tree-lined boulevard after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後，我們沿著林蔭大道散步。

examples.en: The hotel is located on a busy boulevard.
examples.zh: 這家飯店位於一條繁忙的大馬路上。

examples.en: Cafés and shops line both sides of the boulevard.
examples.zh: 咖啡館和商店沿著大道兩旁排開。

examples.en: My sister wears a brace on her teeth.
examples.zh: 我妹妹的牙齒戴著牙套。

examples.en: He wore a knee brace after the soccer game.
examples.zh: 足球賽後，他戴著護膝支架。

examples.en: The carpenter added a brace to hold the shelf.
examples.zh: 木匠加了一根支架來撐住架子。

examples.en: Brace the table with a piece of wood.
examples.zh: 用一塊木頭把桌子撐穩。

examples.en: We must brace ourselves for the cold winter.
examples.zh: 我們必須為寒冷的冬天做好準備。

examples.en: She held the rail to brace herself on the moving bus.
examples.zh: 她抓著扶手，在行駛的公車上穩住身體。

examples.en: She bought a new brassiere at the department store.
examples.zh: 她在百貨公司買了一件新的胸罩。

examples.en: The store sells brassieres in many sizes.
examples.zh: 這家店販售各種尺寸的胸罩。

examples.en: A comfortable brassiere is important for sports.
examples.zh: 舒適的胸罩對運動很重要。

examples.en: The breadth of the river is about fifty meters.
examples.zh: 這條河的寬度約五十公尺。

examples.en: She impressed us with the breadth of her knowledge.
examples.zh: 她知識的廣博令我們印象深刻。

examples.en: The table is two meters in length and one in breadth.
examples.zh: 這張桌子長兩公尺、寬一公尺。

examples.en: A car breakdown made us late for the meeting.
examples.zh: 車子故障讓我們開會遲到了。

examples.en: He had a nervous breakdown after months of stress.
examples.zh: 承受了好幾個月的壓力後，他精神崩潰了。

examples.en: The manager gave us a breakdown of the monthly costs.
examples.zh: 經理給了我們每月成本的明細。

examples.en: She was sad after the breakup with her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 和男友分手後，她很難過。

examples.en: The breakup of the band surprised many fans.
examples.zh: 樂團解散讓許多粉絲很意外。

examples.en: The breakup of the ice in spring is a beautiful sight.
examples.zh: 春天冰層碎裂的景象很美。

examples.en: The little boy stood at the brink of the pond.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩站在池塘邊。

examples.en: The company was on the brink of closing down.
examples.zh: 這家公司瀕臨倒閉。

examples.en: The two countries stood on the brink of war.
examples.zh: 兩國處於戰爭的邊緣。
